messages:
Alex Reyes: quick status check — StableFold kernel PR #4828 landed to canary this morning. Perf looks good for short seqs but we're seeing ~12% p99 increase on >1024 tokens on node group b. @Devon @Priya are you able to triage ownership and next steps?
Maria Chen: acked. thanks for flagging. i ran a couple of raw traces, looks like KV read amplification in the new hotpath when the suffix cache misses. sending logs. :mag:
Devon Patel: digging in now. first pass: the new prefetch branch is issuing duplicate KV fetches when the prefix length crosses the microbatch boundary. i'll add a debug log and a cheap dedupe in the handler to validate.
Priya Singh: ping on infra capacity — canary load was slightly higher this morning (spike from automated smoke). i'll scale the canary down a notch to reduce noise while debugging. :small_blue_diamond: keeping traffic stable.
Alex Reyes: thanks. can we also get a quick experiment to compare continuous-batching=on vs off for the same request mix? might show whether batching heuristics interact with the regression. @ci-bot do we have a smoke experiment template?
ci-bot: experiment template available: `infra/experiments/continuous-batch-comparison.yaml`. To run: `./tools/run_experiment --template continuous-batch-comparison.yaml --env canary`.
Devon Patel: nailed the duplicate fetch repro locally with a short script. patch incoming (will push to PR as `WIP: dedupe kv fetch`). estimate 30–45m for tests + canary redeploy.
Maria Chen: i pushed a small profiler snapshot to the thread: https://internal-ops/profiles/4828/slot1 — bottom line: ~60% of extra time is spent in `kv_client.get_many` overhead when items > 128.
Priya Singh: redeploy scheduled at +45m to avoid peak. i'll coordinate with release window. can someone add a blameless note to the incident tracker if we hit >10% regression post-deploy?
Alex Reyes: yep — i'll add an async blameless note after we confirm. Devon — once you have the WIP, can you include a simple microbenchmark (script + results) so we can gate on perf before merging?
Devon Patel: yes. adding `bench/stablefold/dedupe_kv.py` and posting results here. will tag @Maria for profiler run once canary is back.
Maria Chen: nice — if the cheap dedupe removes the dupes without altering scheduling, we can then look at whether a follow-up prefetch coalescer is required.
Priya Singh: heads-up: if we need a more invasive coalescer, that could touch the runtime-hotpath which needs a cross-team review. marking as potential dependency for next sprint. :memo:
Alex Reyes: good call. for now, action items: (1) Devon: push WIP patch + microbench (ETA ~45m). (2) Priya: hold canary scale and redeploy in safe window. (3) Maria: run profiler snapshot after canary redeploy and post results. i'll update tracking ticket `SRT-221` with ownership and next milestone.
Devon Patel: WIP pushed: https://gh/redwood/pr/4828 — bench results attached, initial patch removes duplicate fetch and restores p99 to baseline in local sim. requesting review from @Maria and @Alex. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: reviewing now. quick nit: can you make the dedupe use a small fixed hash instead of a full dict to reduce allocs? will comment inline.
Alex Reyes: thanks team. this feels like a fast follow — keep updates here. i'll also ping eng-oncall if anything unexpected surfaces after redeploy. :eyes:
